description: Create TopicHub model and supporting sub-models (TopicSource, TopicMCQ, TopicPYQ, TopicRelation) as a new Beanie Document, then register it with Beanie init and add collection indexes.
steps: Create apps/backend/app/models/topic_hub.py with TopicSource, TopicMCQ, TopicPYQ, TopicRelation (BaseModel subclasses) and TopicHub (Document subclass) following the exact schema from the user request. Import datetime, timezone, Optional, PydanticObjectId, Field from beanie/pydantic. Add Settings class with name='topic_hubs' and indexes on topic_slug, chapter_id, subject_id, and compound (topic_slug, chapter_id).

Modify apps/backend/app/db/mongo.py: import TopicHub from app.models.topic_hub and add it to the document_models list in init_beanie(). Also add an index creation call in create_indexes() for the topic_hubs collection: compound index on (topic_slug, chapter_id) unique, plus single-field indexes on subject_id.
Verify the model can be imported cleanly by running: python -c 'from app.models.topic_hub import TopicHub, TopicSource, TopicMCQ, TopicPYQ, TopicRelation'
acceptance_criteria: TopicHub Document model exists in apps/backend/app/models/topic_hub.py with all fields from the spec
TopicHub is registered in the Beanie init_beanie document_models list in db/mongo.py
All sub-models (TopicSource, TopicMCQ, TopicPYQ, TopicRelation) are importable
Running 'python -c "from app.models.topic_hub import TopicHub"' succeeds without import errors
